mapper.select: SELECT rr.`resource_key` FROM `role_resource` rr JOIN `role` r ON r.`role_id` = rr.`role_id` AND r.`is_deleted` = 0 WHERE rr.`role_id` = #{roleId} ORDER BY rr.`resource_key`

SELECT DISTINCT rr.`resource_key` FROM `role_member` rm JOIN `role` r ON r.`role_id` = rm.`role_id` AND r.`enable` = 1 AND r.`is_deleted` = 0 JOIN `role_resource` rr ON rr.`role_id` = r.`role_id` JOIN `resource` res ON res.`key` = rr.`resource_key` WHERE rm.`member_id` = #{memberId} ORDER BY rr.`resource_key`

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rm.`member_id`) FROM `role_member` rm JOIN `role` r ON r.`role_id` = rm.`role_id` AND r.`enable` = 1 AND r.`is_deleted` = 0 JOIN `role_resource` rr ON rr.`role_id` = r.`role_id` WHERE rr.`resource_key` = #{resourceKey}
